rows.grounds: points to the hidden true nature as the object of knowledge
expresses the prior act of realization leading to the result
compound denoting the concealed essential reality that is known

items.question: What state arises from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: The hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a decisive act.
All-knowingness arises as a result of that knowing.
items.inference: Realization of the hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
